name: Econo Trade India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1982, Econo Trade India Ltd is in the business of providing loans and making investments[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
ETIL is a Kolkata-based company that is registered as a non-systematically important deposit-taking non-banking financial company. The company is in the business of offering loans and Inter Corporate Deposit to the corporate clients. It also makes investments in shares and securities.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.29 times its book value
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 365 days to 108 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 5.25% over last 3 years.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
